title: IUCN Great Ape Health Guidelines.pdf
sample_text: Official protocols for monitoring respiratory outbreaks in wild mountain gorilla populations. Recommends a strict 7-meter distance limit for trackers and researchers. If vocalized coughing or deep nasal discharge is observed in more than 15 percent of a habituated group, field teams must immediately flag the event for veterinary sample collection via darting protocols.

title: Gorilla Doctors Respiratory Manual.pdf
sample_text: Clinical assessment rules for wild mountain gorillas experiencing cold-stress induced respiratory infections. Symptoms present as heavy wheezing, bilateral nasal discharge, and deep lethargy. Early containment involves isolating the ranging group from tourist exposure windows and increasing field monitoring cycles to twice daily.

title: AZA Captive Gorilla Husbandry Guidelines.pdf
sample_text: Husbandry and handling procedures for western lowland gorillas in managed care settings. Sections include dietary management, enclosure configuration, and captive quarantine steps. Note: Quarantine protocols for acute aerosol transmission containment apply to broader zoonotic management scenarios but do not replace wild population tracking rules.

title: EAZA Primate Respiratory Isolation Protocol.pdf
sample_text: European association standards for managing airborne disease clusters in primate enclosures. Detail intensive intervention steps including immediate physical air filtration changes and medical isolation zones. Helpful for defining cross-zoonotic transmission boundaries between staff and great apes.

title: Study on Human Lipoprotein and Heart Health.pdf
sample_text: Clinical evaluation of human cardiovascular trends. Explores serum lipids, low density lipoprotein distribution, and atherosclerotic markers in human test cohorts across urban environments.

title: Evaluation of E-Cigarette Vapor Inhalation.pdf
sample_text: Toxicological review of aerosolized nicotine delivery vectors in domestic laboratory environments. Analyzes human pulmonary impacts and inner ear exposures to volatile organic compounds.
